slides.quote: Plant- and bacteria-based dyestuffs, made in Jaipur for mills, brands and artisans who want colour without the pollution.

slides.title: Colour from plants & waste
slides.body: 30% of our colours come from plant waste: pomegranate peel, onion skin, marigold petals, areca nut and lac.

slides.title: Built for industrial dyeing
slides.body: Concentrated extracts made for commercial dye houses, alongside traditional dye powders for artisans.

slides.title: Research-led
slides.body: Our R&D facility is at ECH, University of Rajasthan, where we also work on colour from microbes.

slides.title: Organic cotton, too
slides.body: We also offer organic cotton handloom fabric, ready for natural dyeing or printing.
